en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 29. And with the first chain of narration from ‘Ali ibn Mahzyar, from al-Hasan, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama’ah, who said: I heard him say (i.e. Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him):
"Why do you cause grief to the Prophet of Allah?" Someone asked: "May I be your ransom, how do we do that?"
He said: "Do you not know that your deeds are persented before him; when he sees the sins committed, he is grieved. So do not cause him grief. Make him happy (with good deeds and obedience)."
